| Metric | Value | Assessment |
|--------|-------|------------|
| Champion File | *(empty)* | ❌ No strategy loaded |
| Degenerate Folds | 19/19 | ❌ Complete degeneracy |
| Exposure | 0.0 / 0.0 | ❌ No positions taken |
| Run Hash | unified_baseline | Placeholder baseline |

## Diagnosis

This is a **fresh lane** with no viable strategy yet. The "unified_baseline" run is the null starting point—zero exposure and all folds degenerate by design.

## Next Commands

```
python run_aub.py --lane ost_v62_unified --explore-signals --top 20
python run_aub.py --lane ost_v62_unified --candidate signals/momentum_base.py --mode quick
python run_aub.py --lane ost_v62_unified --promote-best --if-beats 2.0
```

## Rationale

1. **explore-signals**: Scan feature space for viable entry/exit signals before committing to full runs
2. **candidate quick-mode**: Test a foundational momentum strategy with reduced fold count to validate pipeline
3. **promote-best**: Auto-promote if any candidate beats OOS mean of 2.0 (low bar for initial progress)

---

*Priority: Signal exploration → Quick validation → Full run on promising candidates*
